calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT '2026-02-23'::DATE AS start_date, '2026-03-22'::DATE AS end_date
),
weekly AS (
    -- Sum closing stock by store, week, and category for the West region in P11
    SELECT fs.week_ending_date, cp.category,
           SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units, SUM(fs.closing_value) AS closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs   ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
      AND cs.region = 'West'
      AND cs.store_id < 900 
      AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
-- Average closing value by category across all weeks in the period
SELECT category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT week_ending_date) AS weeks_in_period,
       ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_closing_value_eur
FROM weekly
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
